purpose: Prevent the cross-version winner from being delivered before actual proposal-only, observable-only and projected/full small25 e200 evidence exists.
implemented: observable-only exact e200 next-update dynamics-state and evaluation identity enforcement; candidate/git identity metadata is excluded only after both checkpoint sidecars are independently verified
proposal-only challenger detection that blocks final selection
cross-version final CANDIDATE/RESULTS/ALTERNATES/report materialization without importing sibling candidate code
resource_policy: Only the eventual winner receives long-horizon ablations. High-end GPUs use concurrent independent batch-1 streams; scientific batch size is not enlarged.
